cohort: The study included 430 pregnant women from two primary health centres in Chandigarh, India, during 2021-2022.
finding: COVID-19 vaccination in pregnant women was associated with significantly lower neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates, while other feto-maternal and neonatal outcomes were similar between vaccinated and unvaccinated groups, suggesting vaccination might be safe.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (normal vaginal/caesarean section/forceps) was evaluated and found to be similar between vaccinated and unvaccinated pregnant women.
